arguments.message: When you switch to a new phone and reinstall the authenticator app, the codes it generates will no longer match the ones Meridian has because the original secret was tied to the old install. To fix this, go to Settings → Security → Two‑factor authentication, tap **Reset**, and set up 2FA again just like a first‑time enrollment – scan the new QR code and confirm with the fresh six‑digit code. If you still have a recovery code from the original setup, you can use it to sign in and reset the 2FA from the settings page.
